archetypes.name: report-counts
archetypes.rationale: Issue counting now spans markdown, structured NDJSON, and fallback bodies.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the execution issue counting paths for consistent category splits and fence handling. Pay close attention to structured rows with zero, one, or multiple bullets and to fallback body_text parsing when NDJSON rows are mixed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: launcher-workdirs
archetypes.rationale: CI launcher workdir resolution affects external tool write targets.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review Codex and Cursor CI launcher workdir resolution. Verify resolved consumer repositories are used consistently in argv, trust config, retry cwd, metadata, and stall monitoring while explicit Codex exec workdirs remain untouched. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: plan-trailers
archetypes.rationale: Plan materialization must remove provenance without deleting real plan content.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review terminal plan provenance stripping for trailer-region edge cases. Check behavior with optional size trailers, missing diff_lines, prose examples, and code fences. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
